CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(PersonBirthdate), NULL, IF( AND(MONTH(PersonBirthdate) = 2, DAY(PersonBirthdate) = 29), IF( DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), 3, 1) >= TODAY(), DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), 3, 1) - TODAY(), DATE(YEAR(TODAY()) + 1, 3, 1) - TODAY() ), IF( DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(PersonBirthdate), DAY(PersonBirthdate)) >= TODAY(), DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(PersonBirthdate), DAY(PersonBirthdate)) - TODAY(), DATE(YEAR(TODAY()) + 1, MONTH(PersonBirthdate), DAY(PersonBirthdate)) - TODAY() ) ) )
CustomField.label: Days Until Birthday
